ana: noticing a latency spike on cluster-gamma starting ~11:04, p50 jumped from 90ms -> 750ms, any recent deploys? :eyes:
jordan: not from infra side, CI shows no rollout. seeing a weird top-down in kernel selection counts though — lots of fallback kernels picked.
sam: pulling profiler now, but quick note — telemetry shows surge of very long prompts + tool-call loops from tenant-542. looks like streaming backpressure too.
lee: can you paste the profiler snippet? esp kernel_select and kv_hit_rate.
sam: paste below (trimmed):
```
timestamp:1978001236 kernel_select: chosen=generic-fallback quant_mode=none reason=missing-optimized
batch_size:1 avg_seq_len:6200 kv_cache_hits:0 kv_cache_evictions:48 gpu_util:22% qps:120
stream_backpressure_ms:2400 tool_calls_per_request:6 tenant_id:542
```
ana?: that avg_seq_len is insane, 6k tokens. our kernel picker probably misclassified and picked non-optimized path. evictions explain kv miss.
jordan: also saw a burst of large batches from tenant-990 earlier that temporarily consumed prefetch slots — noisy neighbor effect. they had many small requests but with extreme concurrency, took scheduler slots.
lee: timeline looks like: tenant-990 churn at 11:03:50 -> prefetch queues full -> tenant-542 long prompt hits at 11:04:05 -> kernel fallback + kv thrash -> streaming stalls -> latency spike.
mike-bot: alert: cluster-gamma latency SLO breach (p95>1s) at 1978001239.
sam: repro locally with a synthetic load: long prompt + tool-loop + concurrent small bursts reproduces kernel fallback. patch suggestion: prefer stable optimized kernel families for >1k seq if quantized weights available, and increase kv retention for streaming sessions.
lee: also suggest temporary mitigation: pin tenant-542 to dedicated kernel variant (avx-int8) and deprioritize tenant-990 on scheduler for 5m. can we throttle tenant-990?
jordan: applied soft-throttle to tenant-990 concurrency limit -> drop from 400 -> 50 concurrent requests, immediate drop in prefetch pressure.
nana?: i mean ana: deployed a quick scheduler tweak to raise priority for sessions with active streaming and high kv_hit potential. will monitor.
deploy-bot: rollout started: scheduler-priority-fix -> canary on cluster-gamma (1/3 nodes) at 1978001275.
sam: after throttle + canary: kv_evictions down to 2, kernel_select favors optimized kernels again, p50 back to ~110ms. still watching for tail.
lee: follow-up action items: (1) tune kernel-selector ML heuristic to use avg_seq_len + tool_call_count (2) add eviction budget per-tenant for streaming sessions (3) long-term: detect tool-call loops as replay pattern and apply adaptive batching.
jordan: noted. i'll open eval + perf ticket and assign.
nana?: thanks all — good quick containment. we'll post a short incident note in #incidents after we confirm stability. :thumbsup:
